mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies near Badger Prairie County Park and a waning gibbous moon. The International Space Station will be visible for 2 minutes starting at 5:07 AM tomorrow, traveling from the northwest near Verona High School toward the east northeast. It is 57 degrees now, with an overnight low of 39 degrees and no rain expected.

Winter alternate-side parking rules are in effect from November 20 through April 1, requiring you to park on even or odd sides of the street between 1 a.m. and 6 a.m. Additionally, please note the Verona Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.

We have a busy schedule! Today you can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy the Thursday night festivities at ART House 360, or play Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow features live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, plus the Main Street Trick-or-Treat event.
In our weekly police report, on October 25, officers discovered a 40-year-old man passed out behind the wheel at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, leading to an arrest for O W I.
The flavor of the day is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. The store is currently open and will remain so until 10 PM tonight, so stop by and enjoy a scoop before they close.
